		Cricsheet Cricket Data
	

This dataset contains structured cricket match data sourced from Cricsheet, an open-source project providing detailed ball-by-ball data for cricket matches up to April 2026.

	
		
		Contents
	


Ball-by-ball JSON files for various cricket formats and leagues
Player and match metadata
